message: kukulu_plan_commit({ renumber: true }) rewrites ids in PLAN.md, PROGRESS.md and kukulu.json's from values but not in CLAUDE.md, so a flight-notes section that cites task ids (a constraint's activating task, a tool-count milestone) had to be pre-edited by hand to the post-renumber ids before the same call that renumbers and commits.

A task_done log entry that contained the macron letter (I wrote a unicode escape in the JSON param, which decodes) was committed into docs/PROGRESS.md, and check-names then failed every kukulu_verify. There is no tool to amend a log line, so I had to edit PROGRESS.md by hand once. kukulu_task_done should validate or reject text that the project's own lint would refuse, or a log-amend tool should exist.
